items.q: What is IFZA and what makes it perfect for company formation in Dubai?
items.a: IFZA is one of the top free zones in Dubai, known for its cheap setup, 100% foreign ownership, and flexible licensing. Zero corporate or personal income tax — ideal for global entrepreneurs, SMEs and startups.

items.q: How quick is company setup in IFZA?
items.a: Typically 2-3 working days with professional assistance. We can fast-track it further if needed.

items.q: What licenses can I get with IFZA?
items.a: Commercial, Professional, Industrial, Offshore, Tourism, and Metaverse/Virtual Assets licenses.

items.q: Can I run my business remotely with IFZA?
items.a: Yes. IFZA's digital portal allows 99% online setup and management — perfect for remote founders.
Yes. Full foreign ownership with 100% repatriation of profits and capital — no local sponsor required.

items.q: Is there corporate tax or income tax in IFZA?
items.a: No. 0% corporate tax and 0% personal income tax — the most favorable jurisdiction in the UAE.

items.q: What office space options does IFZA provide?
items.a: Flexi Desk, Smart Offices, Dedicated Office Spaces, and Property Services in Dubai Silicon Oasis.

items.q: Can you help me open a bank account for my IFZA company?
items.a: Yes. We work with top UAE banks to get your corporate account set up with minimal documentation.

items.q: What compliance support does IFZA offer?
items.a: UBO compliance, ESR compliance, AML compliance, VAT advisory, license renewal, and PRO services.

items.q: How much does IFZA setup cost?
items.a: License from AED 11,500 + Flexi-desk AED 7,500-9,000 + visa AED 4,500-6,500. Typical Year 1 total: AED 24,000 - 35,000.
